pages.text: This diary is your $(bold)main quest guide$(0): follow the 7 stages and you'll never lose your way.$(br2)$(bold)1. Mine ore → 2. Refine essence → 3. Build the energy grid → 4. Mass-produce with machines → 5. Automate with the Miner → 6. Advanced industry (ingots/gear/catalysts/logistics) → 7. Reactor & Fusion.$(br2)$(bold)How to read it:$(0) each page tells you "what to do first and why," then points you to the entry with the details; $(bold)blue text$(0) is clickable. Don't skip the $(c)red warnings$(0) — they're the lessons that explode.

$(bold)Stage 1 · Mining:$(0) head underground for "$(l:akaishi:ore)Akaishi Ore Clusters$(/l)" — the Overworld, Nether and End all host them, and one swing drops a few crystals. That's your first fortune.$(br2)$(bold)Stage 2 · Processing:$(0) craft 9 crystals into a Raw Akaishi Block, feed it to the Purifier to squeeze out essence, then concentrate it further. The full "crystal → block → essence → concentrate" chain and its fuel value live in "$(l:akaishi:crystal)Crystal & Essence$(/l)".$(br2)As for the hard currency to come, "$(l:akaishi:ingot)Akaishi Ingot$(/l)" — give it a quick look so you know the face.$(br2)$(4)Start hoarding Raw Akaishi Blocks now$(0) — generators and the purifier both eat them.

$(bold)Stage 3 · The Akaishi Energy grid:$(0) a lone machine spins for nothing — automation needs power first. Read "$(l:akaishi:energy_basics)Akaishi Energy Basics$(/l)", build the "$(l:akaishi:generator)Energy Generator$(/l)" to burn fuel into power, store it in Energy Cells, then pipe it to every machine.$(br2)$(bold)Stage 4 · Machine production:$(0) run the "$(l:akaishi:pulverizer)Pulverizer$(/l)" to grind ores into dust, press dust back into blocks with the Compressor, and round out materials with the Transformer and Plant Cultivator.$(br2)Why the basic machines first? Pulverizing and pressing are prerequisites for a whole pile of recipes — $(4)get the grid humming before you automate$(0).

$(bold)Stage 5 · Miner automation:$(0) once materials allow, build the "$(l:akaishi:miner_structure)Miner Structure$(/l)" — a massive multiblock that mines vanilla ores for you. No more hand mining.$(br2)$(bold)Stage 6 · Advanced industry:$(0) condense Netherite Ingots into Akaishi Ingots with the Energy Aggregator, grow crystals on autopilot with the "$(l:akaishi:catalyst)Catalyst$(/l)" while a Collector harvests, move goods through Item Pipes, then forge your "$(l:akaishi:equipment)Equipment$(/l)" at the Equipment Forger.$(br2)This stage devours materials — $(e)expand the grid before you start$(0).

$(bold)Stage 7 · Advanced power:$(0) when your grid can't feed the big machines, swap the heart. Study "$(l:akaishi:fuel_system)Fuel & Cooling$(/l)" first, then take on the "$(l:akaishi:reactor)Reactor$(/l)" — one unit outshines dozens of generators, at the price of mastering heat.$(br2)Past the reactor lie the "$(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l)", the liquid-fuel and plasma chains, and wireless energy for cross-dimension transmission.$(br2)$(c)Remember: reactors explode$(0) — overheating starts a 10-second countdown, so always keep an escape route.$(4)Fusion is the endgame of power$(0). Take it slow.

$(bold)Progress check$(0): if you can answer "where to mine, where power comes from, how dust is made, and how the Miner is built," you're safe to push on; for the late game, finish the reactor's heat-control lesson first.$(br2)$(4)Beyond Akaishi Energy lies Life Energy$(0) — craft the Book of Life and we'll meet in that manual.
